items.t: Companies (Ind AS) Amendment Rules, 2026 (G.S.R. 725(E))
items.b: MCA, in consultation with NFRA, amended five standards: Ind AS 109 and 107 (classification of financial assets with contingent/ESG-linked features, settlement of liabilities through electronic payment systems, nature-dependent electricity contracts), and Annual Improvements to Ind AS 101, 107, 109, 110 and 7. Applicable for annual reporting periods beginning on or after 1 April 2026.

items.t: Ind AS 118 Presentation and Disclosure – recommended by NFRA
items.b: Ind AS 118 (based on IFRS 18) will replace Ind AS 1. It introduces operating, investing and financing categories in the statement of profit and loss, mandatory subtotals, disclosure of management-defined performance measures and enhanced aggregation guidance. ICAI issued the Exposure Draft on 6 January 2025; NFRA recommended it to the Central Government at its meeting of 22 December 2025. Proposed effective date: annual periods beginning on or after 1 April 2027 (FY 2026-27 comparatives restated). Not yet notified by MCA – watch for the notification.

items.t: Companies (Ind AS) Second Amendment Rules, 2025
items.b: Ind AS 1 – classification of liabilities as current/non-current and non-current liabilities with covenants; Ind AS 7 and 107 – supplier finance arrangement disclosures; Ind AS 12 – International Tax Reform (Pillar Two) temporary exception and disclosures; consequential change in Ind AS 10. Most amendments apply from 1 April 2025.

items.t: Companies (Ind AS) Amendment Rules, 2025 – Ind AS 21 lack of exchangeability (G.S.R. 291(E))
items.b: Specifies when a currency is exchangeable and how to estimate the spot exchange rate when it is not, with disclosures; consequential amendment to Ind AS 101.

items.t: Ind AS (Third Amendment) Rules, 2024 – relief for insurers
items.b: Insurers may continue to provide Ind AS 104-based financial information to their parent/investor/venturer for consolidation until IRDAI notifies Ind AS 117.

items.t: Ind AS 116 – lease liability in a sale and leaseback (Second Amendment Rules, 2024)
items.b: Seller-lessee measures the lease liability so that no gain or loss is recognised on the right of use it retains, including where payments are variable.

items.t: Ind AS 117 Insurance Contracts notified; Ind AS 104 omitted (G.S.R. 492(E))
items.b: Ind AS 117 applies to all entities issuing insurance contracts, for annual periods beginning on or after 1 April 2024.

items.t: Notification 141/2026 – no TDS on dividends between IFSC aircraft-leasing units
items.b: No tax deduction on dividends paid between IFSC units engaged in aircraft leasing, subject to Form 1(N); effective 1 April 2026 under the Income-tax Act, 2025.

items.t: Income-tax (Eighth Amendment) Rules, 2026 – merger of non-profit organisations
items.b: Notification 139/2026 inserts Rule 189A and Form 112A for intimating the merger of registered non-profit organisations with the same or similar objects.

items.t: Income-tax (Sixth Amendment) Rules, 2026 – Form 161 for penalty waiver
items.b: Notification 134/2026 revises Form 161 for applications for waiver of penalty under section 440(2) of the Income-tax Act, 2025.

items.t: Circular 07/2026 – due dates extended for AY 2026-27 (1961 Act)
items.b: For audit cases (Sl. No. 2 of Explanation 2 to s.139(1) of the 1961 Act), due date of return extended from 31 October 2026 to 21 November 2026 and audit report from 30 September 2026 to 21 October 2026. Relates to FY 2025-26 under the 1961 Act.

items.t: Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme, 2026
items.b: Notification 114/2026 notifies the rules and forms for the scheme allowing small taxpayers to disclose foreign assets.

items.t: CBDT FAQs on transition provisions (s.536 – repeal and savings)
items.b: Office Memorandum dated 6 July 2026: proceedings relating to periods before 1 April 2026 generally continue under the 1961 Act; matters for tax year 2026-27 onwards fall under the 2025 Act; clarifications on summons, notices and transfer of jurisdiction.

items.t: Income-tax Act, 2025 in force
items.b: The new Act (536 sections, 23 chapters, 16 schedules) replaced the Income-tax Act, 1961 from 1 April 2026 – applicable from tax year 2026-27.

items.t: Finance Act, 2026 – key direct tax changes
items.b: No change in slabs/rates for tax year 2026-27; amendments to both the 1961 and 2025 Acts; revised return time limit extended to 12 months from end of tax year (fee after 9 months); decriminalisation and rationalisation of certain offences; changes to MAT computation/credit.

items.t: Income-tax Rules, 2026 notified
items.b: New Rules (approx. 333 rules, 190 forms) operationalise the 2025 Act, with revised perquisite valuation limits (e.g. children education and hostel allowance).

items.t: ICAI: Income-tax Act, 2025 applicable from May 2027 CA exams
items.b: Applicable for Intermediate Paper 3A, Final Paper 4 (Direct Tax Laws & International Taxation) and Self-Paced Module Set C Paper 5 from May 2027 examinations onwards (tax year 2026-27).

items.t: 57th GST Council meeting – process reforms (no rate changes)
items.b: Recommended: removal of arrest powers; prosecution threshold raised from ₹1 crore to ₹5 crore; no notice for amounts ≤ ₹10,000; general penalty reduced from ₹25,000 to ₹10,000; faster refunds (acknowledgement in 10 days, 90% risk-based sanction within 3 working days); inverted-duty refund extended to input services (credit from 1 Nov 2026) and plant & machinery (from 1 April 2027, 1/60th per month); wider ITC (employee health/life insurance, free samples etc.); optional annual return for B2C taxpayers up to ₹5 crore. Effective only when the law, rules or notifications are amended.

items.t: GSTAT appeal filing deadline extended to 31 July 2026
items.b: Last date for filing backlog appeals before the GST Appellate Tribunal (orders communicated before 1 April 2026) extended from 30 June 2026 to 31 July 2026 due to portal congestion.

items.t: Finance Act, 2026 – s.13(8)(b) IGST (intermediary) omitted
items.b: Section 157 of the Finance Act, 2026 omits s.13(8)(b) w.e.f. 30 March 2026. POS of intermediary services is now the location of the recipient (s.13(2)); services to foreign principals can qualify as export. Definition of intermediary in s.2(13) unchanged. CGST post-supply discount amendments to take effect from a notified date.

items.t: GST 2.0 rate rationalisation in force
items.b: Two main slabs of 5% and 18% plus a 40% rate for luxury and sin goods replaced the 5/12/18/28% structure (56th Council meeting, 3 September 2025; IGST rate notifications 9/2025 to 17/2025-Integrated Tax (Rate)).

items.t: GSTAT operational – appeal timelines notified
items.b: GST Appellate Tribunal launched in September 2025 with mandatory e-filing under the GSTAT (Procedure) Rules, 2025; timelines notified for backlog appeals.

items.t: Finance Act 2023 / IGST (Amendment) Act 2023 changes effective
items.b: s.10(1)(ca) POS for supplies to unregistered persons; proviso to s.12(8) and s.13(9) omitted; OIDAR and non-taxable online recipient definitions widened; s.14A online money gaming; s.16 zero-rating to SEZ only for authorised operations and IGST-paid exports limited to notified classes.
